newsitem.title: USA: IMM currency futures end pit trading mostly higher.
newsitem.headline: IMM currency futures end pit trading mostly higher.

text.p: Most IMM currency futures ended pit trading moderately higher after busy morning turnover thinned during the afternoon and prices reverted to range-trading.

Futures tried to retest the upside before midday but most units lacked followthrough, and values returned toward the upper portion of day's range for the balance of the session as activity wound down again.
Floor brokers said one managed fund that sold 600 June yen Monday was seen buying contracts Tuesday, possibly as offset, in a move that helped nearby yen firm again near midday.
But that attempt at the upside never gained momentum either, and futures edged back off gain.
"They tried to pick up late but it never got going," said one floor broker.

Yen had risen overnight as Japan's Nikkei stock index rallied and talk resurfaced that a continued Japanese stock market rally might support a Bank of Japan tightening that could help draw investment back into yen-denominated products.
But brokers remained skeptical that a Japanese rate rise would significantly alter capital flows, given the low level of Japan rates and its fragile economy and financial systems.
